name: Dodanim
overview: Dodanim is a male figure noted in Scripture as a son of Javan, placing him within the genealogical records of Genesis 10:4. Beyond this designation, the biblical text does not provide additional tribal affiliation or personal details. His mention serves to trace the lineage of Javan's descendants in the post-Flood world.
namesAndTitles: The name Dodanim appears as a proper name in Genesis 10:4, with no specific meaning or divine origin indicated. An alternative form, Rodanim, is found in 1 Chronicles 1:7, suggesting a variant spelling or pronunciation in the biblical record. No further etymological insight is given in the text.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture identifies Dodanim as a son of Javan, establishing a direct paternal relationship in the genealogical listings. No other family connections or tribal affiliations are recorded beyond this father-son link.
scriptureSignificance: Dodanim's primary significance lies in his place within the genealogical framework that outlines the descendants of Javan, who himself is a descendant of Noah's son Japheth. This lineage helps to map the spread of nations and peoples after the Flood, underscoring God's providential ordering of human history. While Dodanim is not a central character in biblical narratives, his inclusion emphasizes the importance of genealogies in understanding God's unfolding plan.
